negative_cases_and_feedback: Reject +3 for this below-zero case; explain the chosen reference and direction without diagnosing a personal misconception.

prompt.en: The temperature changes from −4 °C to 3 °C. Find the directed change in temperature (°C).
prompt.zh-Hant: 氣溫由 −4 °C 變為 3 °C。求氣溫的有向變化（單位：°C）。

solution.en: Change = final − initial = 3 − (−4) = +7 °C; the temperature rises by 7 °C.
solution.zh-Hant: 變化 = 最後氣溫 − 最初氣溫 = 3 −（−4）= +7 °C，即上升 7 °C。

negative_cases_and_feedback: Reject 3: it is the final temperature, while the question asks for change.
Reject −7; check that initial + change equals final.

prompt.en: A rental costs $12 plus $4 per hour. Half-hours are allowed and charged proportionally. The total is $30. Find the rental time in hours and explain why it is allowed.
prompt.zh-Hant: 租借費為 $12，另加每小時 $4；可租半小時，按比例收費。共付 $30。求租借時間（小時），並說明此時間為何符合規定。

solution.en: Let t be hours. 12 + 4t = 30 gives t = 18/4 = 9/2 = 4.5 hours, an allowed multiple of half an hour. The total checks as 12 + 18 = 30.
solution.zh-Hant: 設租借時間為 t 小時。由 12 + 4t = 30，得 t = 18/4 = 9/2 = 4.5 小時，是半小時的倍數，符合規定。檢驗總費用為 12 + 18 = 30。

hint.en: Remove the fixed fee before dividing by the hourly rate.
hint.zh-Hant: 先扣除固定費用，再除以每小時收費。

negative_cases_and_feedback: Reject 30/4 because it charges the fixed fee as time.
Do not round 4.5 hours to 5; no rounding was requested and it changes the cost.

prompt.en: Two adjacent angles lie on a straight line. One is 48°. Find the other angle x and give a reason.
prompt.zh-Hant: 直線上的兩個鄰角，一個為 48°。求另一角 x，並說明理由。

solution.en: x = 180° − 48° = 132°, because adjacent angles on a straight line sum to 180°.

title.en: Identify pairs without assuming parallel lines
title.zh-Hant: 不假設平行而辨認角對

families.demand: Recognise a transversal and corresponding/alternate-interior/same-side-interior pairs from position, even for nonparallel lines.
families.domain_and_constraints: Two distinct intersections of a transversal with two lines. Include explicitly nonparallel cases; preserve angle-pair identities under rotation/reflection and stable labels. Do not infer equality from pair names.
families.answer_contract: Stable-ID classification choice; no numerical equality claimed without givens.
families.p1_capability: Choice marker exists; a ray/intersection diagram model and label collision checks are new work.
families.visual_and_accessible_alternative: At both intersections mark the chosen sectors using labelled rays. Accessible text specifies intersection, side of transversal and inside/outside band; do not describe only colours.

prompt.en: A transversal t meets lines l and m at different points. The two marked angles are in the same relative position, one at each intersection. Name the pair; l and m are not assumed parallel.
prompt.zh-Hant: 截線 t 分別與直線 l、m 相交於不同點。兩個標示角各位於一個交點，且相對位置相同。指出它們是哪類角對；題目沒有假設 l、m 平行。

solution.en: They are corresponding angles. This describes their positions; it does not by itself assert equal sizes.
solution.zh-Hant: 它們是同位角。這名稱描述相對位置，本身並不表示角度一定相等。

hint.en: Classify positions first; check parallelism only when using an equality property.
hint.zh-Hant: 先按位置分類；使用相等性質時才檢查是否已知平行。

choices.en: Interior angles on the same side

negative_cases_and_feedback: Include a nonparallel drawing with this same classification.
Do not accept an equality claim merely because a pair is corresponding.

title.en: Deduce angles from given parallel lines

families.demand: Use a given parallel premise and an identified angle pair to deduce a size with a reason.

prompt.en: Lines l and m are parallel. A transversal forms corresponding angles of 68° and x. Find x and give a reason.

families.demand: Use angle data to establish or reject parallelism; distinguish a condition from a property with parallelism already given.
families.domain_and_constraints: Specified corresponding/alternate-interior/same-side-interior pair under one transversal. Generate satisfying and non-satisfying cases with valid angles 20…160°. families.visual_and_accessible_alternative: No parallel arrows before conclusion. Draw from chosen line orientations; angle numbers and marked sectors agree. Text specifies which two angles are paired.

prompt.en: A transversal forms interior angles on the same side of 112° and 68°. Must the two lines be parallel? Explain.
prompt.zh-Hant: 一條截線形成的一對同旁內角為 112° 和 68°。這兩條直線是否必定平行？請說明。

solution.en: Yes. 112° + 68° = 180°, so the same-side interior angles are supplementary; this is a condition for the two lines to be parallel.
solution.zh-Hant: 是。112° + 68° = 180°，即同旁內角互補，符合判別兩直線平行的條件。

hint.en: Check the sum and the named angle relationship.
hint.zh-Hant: 檢查角度和，以及題目指定的角對關係。

negative_cases_and_feedback: The near-miss 112° and 67° gives No for that same named pair.
Equality of vertically opposite angles at one intersection alone is insufficient to conclude the two target lines are parallel.

title.en: Triangle interior and exterior angle deductions
title.zh-Hant: 三角形內角與外角的推算

families.demand: Select triangle-sum or exterior-angle reasoning from the requested sector, and name valid reasons.
families.domain_and_constraints: Positive whole-degree A,B,C with sum 180° and each 20…140°; include acute and obtuse triangles. Exterior angle uses the actual extended side and equals the two remote interior angles; label the requested sector explicitly.
families.answer_contract: Exact degree value plus separately reviewed reason; interior/exterior variants share one family.
families.p1_capability: Numeric/reason machinery exists; triangle coordinates and side extension must be generated from the same exact angle data.
families.visual_and_accessible_alternative: Construct triangle via angles/intersections; do not draw an arbitrary triangle with inconsistent labels. Accessible text supplies labelled vertices, extension and all givens.

prompt.en: In triangle ABC, angle A = 47° and angle B = 68°. Find angle C and give a reason.
prompt.zh-Hant: 在三角形 ABC 中，∠A = 47°、∠B = 68°。求 ∠C，並說明理由。

solution.en: C = 180° − 47° − 68° = 65°, since the interior angles of a triangle sum to 180°. The exterior angle adjacent to C would be 115°.

hint.en: Distinguish the requested interior angle from its adjacent exterior angle.
hint.zh-Hant: 先分清題目求的是內角，還是相鄰外角。

negative_cases_and_feedback: Reject 115° when C is the interior angle; reserve that value for the adjacent exterior sector.
Reject generated degenerate triangles before display.

title.en: Explain why triangle angle rules hold
title.zh-Hant: 解釋三角形角度性質的由來

families.demand: Build a short deductive chain from parallel-line and straight-angle facts, then derive the exterior-angle rule.
families.domain_and_constraints: Nondegenerate triangle ABC; line through A parallel BC is a stated construction. Start with a labelled static figure; optional rotation changes appearance only, not proof. No free-proof auto-grading.
families.answer_contract: Open written or structured-statement proof; manual/self rubric. Completing/revealing the model is study, not independent proof evidence.
families.p1_capability: Requires a multi-statement/manual task layout and rubric; the existing single numeric answer is insufficient.
families.visual_and_accessible_alternative: Construct parallel line through A, extend BC at C for the exterior claim, label all relevant rays. Text names construction and which alternate angles correspond.

prompt.en: Draw a line through A parallel to BC in triangle ABC. Use this construction to explain A + B + C = 180°. Then explain why the exterior angle at C equals A + B.
prompt.zh-Hant: 在三角形 ABC 中，過 A 作 BC 的平行線。利用此輔助線解釋 ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°，再解釋 C 點的外角為何等於 ∠A + ∠B。

solution.en: The angles made by AB and AC with the parallel line equal B and C by alternate interior angles. Together with A they form a straight angle, so A+B+C=180°. If E is the exterior angle adjacent to C, E+C=180°, hence E=A+B.
solution.zh-Hant: 由平行線的內錯角相等，AB、AC 與輔助平行線所成的角分別等於 ∠B、∠C。它們與 ∠A 拼成一平角，所以 ∠A+∠B+∠C=180°。設 C 點相鄰外角為 E，則 E+∠C=180°，因此 E=∠A+∠B。

hint.en: Identify the alternate angles at A before using the straight line.
hint.zh-Hant: 先找出 A 點與 ∠B、∠C 相等的內錯角，再利用平角。

rubric: uses correct alternate interior angle correspondences
uses straight-angle sum to derive triangle sum
derives exterior rule using supplementary relation

negative_cases_and_feedback: Do not use the triangle-sum theorem itself as the starting reason for its proof.
A measured drawing or a number-only answer does not establish the general statement.
